title: Scaffold app shell, config, cache and state store
description:
Create index.html (loads js/main.js as type=module), styles.css (tokens on :root, dark mode, mobile layout), js/config.js (BANDS, TTLs, Open-Meteo and OSRM URLs, DAYS, DEFAULT_HOME), js/cache.js (cacheGet/cacheSet with TTL, all storage in try/catch) and js/state.js (createStore -> get/set/subscribe).

Acceptance: page serves via `npx serve` with no console errors; cache survives reload and returns null after TTL; subscribe fires on set.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, sections "Components > cache", "Components > state", "Implementation Notes".

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Done: index.html, styles.css (tokens, dark mode, 375px OK), config/cache/state. Served via npx serve (.claude/launch.json), no console errors.
